64:10.text: (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
, they will be the dwellers of the Fire, to dwell therein forever. And worst indeed is that destination

64:11.text: No calamity befalls, but by the Leave
of Allâh, and whosoever believes in Allâh, He guides his heart
[to the true Faith with certainty, i.e. what has befallen him was already written for him by Allâh from the Qadar (Divine Preordainments)]
. And Allâh is the All-Knower of everything.

64:12.text: Obey Allâh, and obey the Messenger
; but if you turn away, then the duty of Our Messenger is only to convey

64:13.text: (none has the right to be worshipped but He)
therefore, let the believers put their trust.

64:14.text: O you who believe! Verily, among your wives and your children there are enemies for you
(who may stop you from the obedience of Allâh)
; therefore beware of them! But if you pardon
, then verily Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

64:15.text: Your wealth and your children are only a trial, whereas Allâh! With Him is a great reward

64:16.text: So keep your duty to Allâh and fear Him as much as you can; listen and obey, and spend in charity; that is better for yourselves. And whosoever is saved from his own covetousness, then they are the successful ones.

64:17.text: If you lend Allâh a goodly loan
, He will double it for you, and will forgive you. And Allâh is Most Ready to appreciate and to reward, Most Forbearing,

64:18.text: All-Knower of the unseen and seen, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
